messages:
Jamal (Success Ops): quick heads up — short status we can send to affected onboarding customers. keeping it concise + link to office hours recording :wave:
Maya (CS): thanks. can you drop a 2‑sentence status + what we’re doing next? i’ll paste into outreach template.
Jamal (Success Ops): sure — root cause: worker pool exhaustion during a spike in parallel bundle ingestion; mitigation: autoscaler bugfix + manual pool bump; next steps: canary rollout of fix, full rollback plan, and 48h monitoring. sending credits to affected accounts.
Ashok (Eng): confirmed — autoscaler missed scale-up when burst tasks used transient slots. fix pushed at 2024-09-18T18:15Z (deployed to prod), canary looks stable. adding metric for ephemeral slot exhaustion.
Leah (SRE): observed token‑generation latency spike ≈ 11:40–12:20 UTC; error rate peaked at 7%. caused some onboard flows to timeout. we’ve extended retry window and added alert to oncall.
Maya (CS): can you give me one line for customers on ETA for full confidence? they want a timeline for when services will be stable.
Ashok (Eng): ETA: monitoring a 24–48h burn to validate canary. if no regressions, full rollout 36–48h. will update earlier if behavior is normal.
Jamal (Success Ops): draft outbound we plan to send: 
"Hi — we identified an ingestion capacity issue that affected some onboarding jobs yesterday. status: fix deployed and canary healthy; next: full rollout within 36–48h while we monitor; compensation: one month of onboarding credits applied to affected accounts. We’ll follow up with the full RCA and a recording of the office hours Q&A"
Maya (CS): perfect. tiny edits: change "one month" to "one-time onboarding credit" and add link to support form.
Jamal (Success Ops): updated draft with support link: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-credit 
Leah (SRE): postmortem headline for the RCA doc: "Transient autoscaler regression during high-concurrency ingest caused pool starvation — mitigated with code fix, increased guardrails, and improved alerting."
Ashok (Eng): adding action items to the RCA: 1) root cause patch (merged) 2) add synthetic load test for ephemeral slot usage 3) instrument KV cache pressure 4) run playbook rehearsal.
Maya (CS): can we record a 30m office hours tomorrow for high-touch customers? i can host and run through FAQ.
Jamal (Success Ops): yes — office hours scheduled: Tomorrow 17:00 UTC. will record and send link to attendees + to all affected. OpsBot will create event and attach recording later.
OpsBot: Event created: "Onboard impact office hours" — 2024-09-19T17:00:00Z. Recording will be posted to the thread after the meeting.
Maya (CS): volunteer list for live Q&A? i can take the CS side, Jamal you cover credits, Ashok + Leah on tech.
Jamal (Success Ops): confirmed :thumbsup: Ashok, Leah — can you join for 30m?
Ashok (Eng): yep, i’ll be there and bring a brief slide with timelines.
Leah (SRE): yes — i’ll bring monitoring graphs and a short list of mitigations.
Maya (CS): last ask — approved credit amounts? product ok with a single one-time credit per affected account?
Jamal (Success Ops): product signed off for one-time onboarding credit; ops to apply within 48h of outreach.
Maya (CS): thanks everyone. i’ll send the outbound at EOD after a quick legal check.
Jamal (Success Ops): one more: please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve reviewed the customer copy so i can finalize.
Ashok (Eng): :white_check_mark:
Leah (SRE): :white_check_mark:
Maya (CS): :white_check_mark:
Jamal (Success Ops): sending now — will paste final message and link once legal confirms.
OpsBot: Incident ticket #INC-2024-938 created and linked: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2024-938
Jamal (Success Ops): thread closed for now — will update after office hours and when RCA is published. thanks all.
